about: A SAMPLE of the produce command's settings (the production change, decisions D-008, D-013, D-014 and D-015 of its design). Copy it OUTSIDE the repository, set every <...> value, and pass its path as --settings. The bounds, the profile and the character maximum are the values ruled at the Design Gate and are configured amounts, never measurements; the media tool's version check borrows the probe bound and the narration join borrows the decode bound, and neither has a setting of its own. narrationVoice is left empty here: the orchestrator sets the voice the owner decided. Before metered mode, demonstrationProviders is emptied and every endpoint is an https address verified first hand. It holds no secret: credentials are read only from the process environment, by name.
outputRoot: <a folder OUTSIDE the repository, for example C:/MediaCompanyOutput>

endpoints.endpoint: <the speech vendor's API base address, verified first hand>
